name: qkd_astk_ep-ks5-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 (track B) aggregator strip: one row engine's stack slice qkd_astk_ep (8 a strip): the qkd_ectl port (so / si), the engine's scores (2 x 256x128, one a pass, by {k, gam}), its e rows (4 x 64x128, one 512-b row a chunk), the chunk chain's adder stage (the golden's sequential chunk sum walks the slices j = 0..7, token-aligned), M, the command / e-row bus taps, the return chain (score count, running maximum), the column's lanes.  ~11.7k sinks.

RTL, lanes (x), clock pin and pin registers unchanged. Clock: the ks4 spine with macro leaves (OT_SPINE_PORT ck + OT_SPINE_MACRO_LEAF; ks4 4_1_cts hold reached -1.6 ps vs ks3 -41.8) kept.
